captions: A design starts as a composition.
CALPHAD screens it first: one $10 call returns three numbers.
Chapter 1: the composition becomes charge cups, dosed, weighed and pressed.
Chapter 2: melt and atomize. Its output is powder quality.
Chapter 3: sieve the powder and print. Is the build dense and crack-free?
Chapter 4: while the build prints, the kept powder is checked: size, phases, composition, shape. Powder quality, measured.
Chapter 5: cut bars, heat-treat them, pull them at room and elevated temperature. Strength is what the objective scores.
Chapter 6: sections cut, mounted and polished, so the build's pores and cracks can be seen.
Chapter 7: cheaper looks at the same nodes, from the trays.
